latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of buffer-calculator with comprehensive features for molecular biology and biochemistry applications.
- Includes a predefined library of common buffers (PBS, RIPA, TAE), with accurate mass/volume and pH specifications.
- Supports precise mass calculations of solid components and volume calculations for liquid reagents.
- Provides concentration scaling, custom buffer formulation, and detailed, step-by-step preparation instructions.
- Includes best practices, troubleshooting tips, and workflow integration with related laboratory tools and skills.
